description: This file defines the Calls class within the Step\Acceptance namespace, extending AcceptanceTester. It contains methods to create calls and relate calls to modules, utilizing various page object classes like EditView, DetailView, and SideBar, interacting with the CRM UI for testing purposes.

classes.name: Calls
classes.description: Step definition class for handling call-related actions in acceptance tests within the SuiteCRM testing framework.

methods.name: createCall
methods.description: Creates a call with a specified name by interacting with the UI elements to fill out the call creation form.

methods.name: createCallRelateModule
methods.description: Creates a call and relates it to a specified module and module name, with optional parameters for additional form fields.
